recognize_zh: 數顆中型淋巴球，核輪廓不規則、有凹陷或腎形切跡，染色質中度凝集，胞質少且嗜鹼，邊緣有小突起（cytoplasmic blebs），符合T細胞前淋巴球白血病（T-PLL）。
features: Intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Irregular nuclear contours with notches, indentations, and reniform shapes
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous in this field
Scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular borders and small cytoplasmic blebs
Monomorphic population with no smudge cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a monomorphic population of intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. Nuclei are irregular with notches and reniform indentations, and chromatin is moderately condensed without conspicuous nucleoli in this field (consistent with the small-cell variant). The scant cytoplasm is deeply basophilic with irregular borders and small blebs. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD2, CD3, CD5, CD7 bright) and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement is recommended.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells show finely folded cerebriform nuclei and typically lose CD7 and CD26, whereas T-PLL retains strong CD7.
ATLL cells show deeply polylobated flower-like nuclei, express CD25, and are HTLV-1 associated.
B-PLL cells are larger with a single prominent central nucleolus and more abundant cytoplasm, and are B-lineage by flow cytometry.
T-LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and round nuclei.
